problem: The custom brightness control declared a slider role but did not process accessibility value requests or expose the full range metadata.
changes: The existing egui Slider now owns pointer dragging, keyboard focus, range metadata and accessibility actions while its default paint is suppressed beneath the existing gradient/marker. Click-and-drag interaction preserves coalesced click handling; endpoint mapping follows egui circle geometry. Arrow presses are consumed after native processing to avoid repeated-layout duplicate steps. A focused thumb has an accent ring. Root dependencies and color-engine semantics are unchanged.

gui.scope: Full final UI suite passes. A new 1x/2x single-versus-repeated-layout test sends accessibility values 0/1/0.5, checks range/value metadata, visible focus, staged editor state, equal one-arrow results across layouts, Cancel preference preservation and OK adoption without document/history changes. Existing coalesced pointer, endpoint retention, RGB/HSL and responsive dialog checks pass.

gpu.scope: Ten fresh light/dark desktop/model-popup/compact captures, including focus after an accessibility-driven 0.5 brightness update. Existing rounded-corner/interior pixel checks pass.

checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: Accessibility evidence is synthetic egui AccessKit input and metadata; physical VoiceOver/Narrator behavior is not qualified. Native egui keyboard stepping replaces the former fixed manual increment, with consistency checked across layout passes. Full Windows/color-editor fidelity and the wider roadmap remain incomplete.
